LanguageData.Cultist.InquiryDescription: An inspector asks how the society obtained its books. If you accept, you have three days. Place a book of Lantern lore near the altar and have the leader file it as evidence. A missed deadline adds fear to the leader.
LanguageData.Cultist.ScholarDescription: Follow the dispatch to the survey shelter. Have a society member read the notebook left there. The parcel also holds a cracked mirror you can bring home to repair.
LanguageData.Cultist.WitnessDescription: After accepting, send {0} different society members other than the leader to the altar to sign. Their testimony will be remembered after the vigil.
LanguageData.Cultist.EndingWitnesses: The witnesses note the hour and close the register.
